<@ba.rem>When an enemy is defeated with this skill, skill activates and sheathes again automatically

levels.name: Countergambit
levels.description:
Deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage to 6 enemies in front, inflicts <$ba.cold>Cold</> on them and removes their <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> for <@ba.vup>{cold}</> seconds; the Operator nearest to 'Eye of the Blizzard' has <@ba.vup>-{cost}</> DP Cost (Prioritizes <@ba.vup>Guard/Caster/Sniper</> Operator on the right); All Operators to the left of 'Eye of the Blizzard' cast this skill <@ba.vup>with their own ATK</> once when deployed (stacks 2 times) 
<@ba.rem>Can store 2 charges</>

levels.description:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, removes enemies' <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{bird_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and inflict <@ba.vup>{damage_scale_display:0%}</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> to targets in a straight line; immediately gains <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_3[start_cost].cost}</> DP, then gradually gains <@ba.vup>24</> DP

Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, removes enemies' <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>{bird_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage and inflict <@ba.vup>{damage_scale_display:0%}</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> to targets in a straight line; immediately gains <@ba.vup>{svash2_s_3[start_cost].cost}</> DP, then gradually gains <@ba.vup>24</> DP
<@ba.rem>On first skill activation, swaps the DP Cost of the Operator with the highest Cost (Prioritizes Guard/Caster/Sniper Operators) with the lowest in the Deployment Waiting Zone</>
<@ba.rem>'Eye of the Blizzard' is deployable when skill is active</>

After <$ba.chant>Chanting</> for <@ba.vdown>{chant_duration}</>s, consumes <@ba.vdown>{sp_cost}</> <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</> to create a familiar to attack; ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, attacks <$ba.sluggish>Slow</> all targets for <@ba.vup>{attack@sluggish}</>s.
Skill can be activated again to upgrade the familiar; attack range <@ba.vup>+1</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>, attacks <$ba.stun>Stun</> the main target for <@ba.vup>{attack@stun}</>s
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration. Skill can be manually deactivated during first activation</>

levels.name: Explosion Magic
levels.description:
After <$ba.chant>Chanting</> for <@ba.vdown>{chant_duration}</>s, consumes <@ba.vdown>{skill_cost_min_sp}</> <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</> to create an explosion in front of the unit at max range; explosion deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to surrounding enemies and causes high ground tiles to collapse, <$ba.stun>Stunning</> them for <@ba.vup>{stun}</>s
<$ba.chant>Chanting</> can be extended for <@ba.vdown>{extra_chant_duration}</>s; upon completion, consumes <@ba.vdown>all remaining</> <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</>; for every <@ba.vdown>{sp_cost_extra}</> additional <$ba.magicpoint>Mana</> consumed, create 1 additional explosion
<@ba.rem>Extended chanting can be manually deactivated</>

When against the same target, gradually increases damage up to a maximum of <@ba.vup>3</>x and gradually reduces its Movement Speed to up to <@ba.vup>40%</> (max effect reached after 5s). The locked-on target and the effects are reset when the skill is interrupted, or when the target is defeated.

Spends <@ba.vup>1</> Coin to place a Champagne Bomb on a ground tile within range that is passable and can be deployed upon; the Champagne Bomb deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK as Physical damage to the first target it comes in contact with and <$ba.sluggish>Slows</> for <@ba.vup>{sluggish}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>The Champagne Bomb deals additional damage after having been deployed for 3 seconds; a maximum of 4 Coins may be held while this Skill is equipped</>

levels.description:
Attacks hit twice, and gain 1 Coin upon defeating an enemy; when skill is manually deactivated, <@ba.vup>all</> Coins will be spent to randomly attack enemies in a frontal area. Each Coin spent in this manner hits once for <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK as Physical damage and knocks the target back <@ba.vup>slightly</>
<@ba.rem>Unlimited duration, can be manually deactivated at any time; a maximum of 10 Coins may be held while this Skill is equipped</>

Passive Effect: When a stone is triggered, deals <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to all enemies within 3 tiles, but only in directions parallel to any links said stone has, and reduces their Movement Speed by <@ba.vup>{display_move_speed:0%}</> for <@ba.vup>{attack@duration}</>s
Active Effect: Gain 2 stones

levels.name: All-Dominating Fight
levels.description:
Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage
Active Effect: <@ba.vdown>Stops attacking</> but <@ba.vup>Attack Range expands</>; grants <@ba.vup>{cnt}</> stones, then any stones above the limit <@ba.vup>are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies</>; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed <@ba.vup>on tiles with enemies</> and <@ba.vup>Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones</> at the cost of an equal amount of ammo
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants {trigger_time} ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones</>
